scope: Pinned WLC/OSHB and editor-read BDB digital reproduction; not manuscript photographs or a full witness collation

sources.finding: The entry lists both Gen3:15 verb forms together. This supports noting lexical repetition but does not prove equal injury or forbid contextual translation differences.
Gen3:15 is listed under animal collective offspring and seed of woman. Other sections discuss particular-child uses; lexical gender does not exclude an individual referent.
Gen3:14 appears in the passive-participle curse formula list. This entry alone does not settle comparative/separative min.

limits: Gemini received the disclosed editor summary; it did not independently retrieve BDB.
Gemini round1 le-kha accusative label and Korean contamination of v14 quotation are not adopted.
No exact LXX or Vulgate edition/witness was collated for this batch; model reports about them remain unverified.
Same-verb translation does not prove equal wounds; individual or collective reference remains discussable.
Claude initial claim of a single speech through v19 does not establish a single addressee; this edition closes the serpent-directed speech at v15.
